@authWelcomeTo.description: First line of the welcome page title; the next line is the app name "Later" in bold. Keep it short: one line in a large font.

authWelcomeSubtitle:
Create an account to see your capsules
and your friends'

@authWelcomeSubtitle.description: Welcome page text under the title. The line break splits it into two balanced lines.

@authGetStarted.description: Big green button on the welcome page that opens the login page.

@authLoginTitle.description: Large heading of the login page.

authLoginSubtitle: Please log in to continue using our app

@authEmailHint.description: Placeholder of the email field (login, sign-up, password reset).

@authLogInButton.description: Big green button that signs in. Keep it short.

@authNoAccount.description: Login page, followed by the authGoToSignUp link.

@authGoToSignUp.description: Bold link after authNoAccount that opens the sign-up page.

@authSignupTitle.description: Large heading of the sign-up page.

authSignupSubtitle: Please fill in the details to create your account

@authNameHint.description: Placeholder of the display name field on the sign-up page.

@authUsernameHint.description: Placeholder of the username field on the sign-up page (the unique @name).

@authSignUpButton.description: Big green button that creates the account. Keep it short.

@authHaveAccount.description: Sign-up page, followed by the authGoToLogIn link.

@authGoToLogIn.description: Bold link after authHaveAccount that opens the login page.

authLegalNotice: By signing up you agree to the {terms} and {privacy}

@authLegalNotice.description: Small print on the sign-up page. {terms} and {privacy} are tappable links (authTermsOfUse, authPrivacyPolicy).

@authTermsOfUse.description: Link inside authLegalNotice: use the grammatical form that fits that sentence.

@authPrivacyPolicy.description: Link inside authLegalNotice: use the grammatical form that fits that sentence.

@authOrConnectWith.description: Above the Google and Facebook sign-in icons.

@authContinueWithGoogle.description: Accessibility label of the Google sign-in icon.

@authFacebookSoon.description: Accessibility label of the Facebook icon (not available yet).

@authResetTitle.description: Title of the password reset dialog.

authResetDescription: Enter your email to receive a password reset link

@authResetSend.description: Button of the password reset dialog. Keep it short (narrow button).

authResetSent: Password reset email sent! Check your inbox.

@authErrorWithMessage.description: Snack bar when the password reset email could not be sent.

authNoFreeUsername: Could not pick a username. Please sign up.

@authNoFreeUsername.description: Google sign-in could not choose a free username automatically; the user should use the sign-up form.

@authPermissionCameraTitle.description: Title of a permission page shown after sign-in (shrinks to fit one line).

authPermissionCameraText: And you will be able to create time capsules!
authPermissionLocationText: And you will be able to find capsules near you!
authPermissionNotificationsText: Stay updated with new followers and capsules!

@authPermissionEnable.description: Button on a permission page that asks for the permission.

authGoogleFailed: Google sign-in failed. Please try again.
authResetUserNotFound: No account found with this email

@authErrorWrongPassword.description: Changing the password, email or deleting the account: the current password is wrong.

authErrorPickGoogleAccount: Please pick the Google account you sign in with.
authErrorRecentLogin: Please confirm it is you and try again.
authErrorEmailTaken: Another account already uses this email.
authErrorUserNotFound: No user found with this email.
authErrorEmailInUse: The account already exists for that email.
authErrorWeakPassword: The password provided is too weak.
authErrorInvalidEmail: The email address is not valid.
authErrorTooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
authErrorMethodDisabled: This sign-in method is not enabled.
